description: List the transfers in this account with their current status, newest first (the dashboard's default order), one page at a time. Paid transfers come in the full view and the rest in the free view, as the dashboard shows them. Archived transfers are left out unless asked for. Pass next_cursor as cursor until it is null. The list holds no bank report times: last_checked_at is when the transfer was last checked, not when a bank last reported; get_transfer gives the newest bank report time. Reading changes nothing.

archived.description: exclude (default): active transfers. include: all. only: archived transfers.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page.

name: list_transfers

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last.

amount.description: The amount entered for the search, as last corrected by the account owner. bank_reported_amount is what a bank reported.

value.description: The amount in the supplied currency's major units, not minor units. For example, 129600 USD means USD 129,600.00.

archived.description: True when the transfer is archived.

value.description: The amount in the supplied currency's major units, not minor units. For example, 129600 USD means USD 129,600.00.

bank_reported_amount.description: The latest amount a bank reported, with its value date. When no bank stated a currency, the currency is the one entered for the search. A free transfer's figure is the one its free tracker shows, from the reports revealed so far.

check_frequency_minutes.description: How often this transfer's own checks run, in the full view; null when it has none scheduled.

checks_finished.description: True when no automatic check is scheduled: a final outcome, an archived transfer, or a closed monitoring window. list_transfers judges the transfer's own entry, as the dashboard shows it; get_transfer judges every lookup of the UETR, as the timeline does.

id.description: The transfer's id in this account.

label.description: The account's own label for the transfer.

last_checked_at.description: When the transfer was last checked, within this account's own monitoring of it: never before added_at, and never after its checks ended.

monitoring_until.description: When this transfer's monitoring window ends or ended (at archiving, if earlier): the paid window, or for a free transfer its free checking window. Checks can finish before it, and a paid transfer still inside its free checking window keeps free checks after it; checks_finished says whether any is scheduled.

payment_date.description: The payment date entered for the search, as last corrected by the account owner.

position_sentence.description: get_transfer only, in the full view: the payment position from its status and verified route. A reporting bank alone never establishes a position. list_transfers and webhook events leave it out.

status_code.description: The latest ISO 20022 status code, in the full view only: the one the transfer's timeline shows as its status, the same in get_transfer, list_transfers and webhook events. In get_transfer it is the code of the last event that carries one, unless a final outcome is kept after its report is no longer listed.

status_explanation.description: What the status code means, in plain English.

view.description: full: every report as the paid timeline shows it. free: the free tracker view.

title: List transfers
